::: {.lead}
An introduction to machine learning: how models learn from data, how to evaluate them honestly, and the main
families of methods, from decision trees and linear models to neural networks, clustering and support vector
machines. Every lecture's slides, notebooks, cheat sheet and short videos are in the
[lecture library](schedule.qmd).
:::

Announcements and discussion are on the course Slack:
[join the ES 335 workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/es335-2025/shared_invite/zt-3a7gi76q8-chqUpxbIdVGaKCsDzIxYcw).

::: {.callout-note}

## Prerequisites

You should be comfortable with:

- **Python programming**, with good experience of data structures and algorithms
- **Probability and statistics**: basic concepts and distributions
- **Linear algebra**: vectors, matrices and their operations
- **Calculus**: derivatives and basic optimisation

### Preparation material

To refresh these before the course begins:

- [Python Data Science Handbook](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/), chapters 1 to 4
- [Linear Algebra for Machine Learning](https://machinelearningmastery.com/linear-algebra-machine-learning/)
- [Khan Academy: Statistics and Probability](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/statistics-probability)
- [Mathematics for Machine Learning](https://mml-book.github.io/book/mml-book.pdf) (free PDF)

## Reference textbooks

Primary references:

1. *Mathematics for Machine Learning*, Deisenroth, Faisal and Ong. [Free PDF](https://mml-book.github.io/book/mml-book.pdf)
2. *An Introduction to Statistical Learning*, James, Witten, Hastie and Tibshirani. [Free online](http://www-bcf.usc.edu/~gareth/ISL/)
3. *Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning*, Christopher Bishop. [Free PDF](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/uploads/prod/2006/01/Bishop-Pattern-Recognition-and-Machine-Learning-2006.pdf)

Additional references:

4. *The Elements of Statistical Learning*, Friedman, Hastie and Tibshirani. [Free PDF](https://web.stanford.edu/~hastie/Papers/ESLII.pdf)
5. *Deep Learning*, Goodfellow, Bengio and Courville. [Free online](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/)
6. *Pattern Classification*, Duda, Hart and Stork
7. *Machine Learning*, Tom Mitchell
8. *Machine Learning: A Probabilistic Perspective*, Kevin Murphy
